title: Admin UI Registration
summary: Registers the app's configuration panel inside Nextcloud's admin settings UI.

title: Configuration Initialization
summary: Populates the app's OpenRegister schemas + registers on first install (and after upgrades that ship a new bundled configuration) from a JSON file committed alongside the app's PHP code.

title: Dashboard Page
summary: Serves the single-page application (SPA) that is the user-facing front end of an OpenSpec-based Nextcloud app.

title: Frontend Data Stores
summary: Per ADR-022, template-derived apps own no database of their own.

title: Observability
summary: Every template-derived app MUST expose two observability endpoints per ADR-006.

title: Settings Management
summary: Defines how a template-derived app reads, writes, and reloads its application configuration.
